name: Rachel Dean
role: Quality and Compliance Coordinator, Sullivan County Regional Health Department
bio:
Rachel Dean is the Quality and Compliance Coordinator at the Sullivan County Regional Health Department. She holds a Bachelor’s degree in Allied Health from East Tennessee State University and a Master of Public Health from East Tennessee State University. She is also a second year examiner for the Tennessee Center of Performance Excellence and currently assisting in facilitating her organization’s Baldrige journey.

In her spare time Rachel enjoys spending time with her friends and family and is currently training for a half-marathon coming up this fall.
